description: What AURIX runs on. Pharos marks a discovered camera capable when its Architecture matches a package and its AXIS OS version is within minAxisOs..maxAxisOs; a chip not listed means untested (unknown), not incompatible.
notes: AXIS OS 13 and later reject unsigned apps: maxAxisOs stays below 13 until AURIX is signed.
ARTPEC-9 is expected to run the aarch64 package but is untested.
minFreeRamMb and minFreeStorageMb are conservative estimates; storage grows with the number of people synced (about 1 KB each).
